CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW premium_gaming_mice AS
SELECT 
    di.devregistry,
    di.makername,
    di.modnum,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (di.dpires / 1000.0) * (1 - di.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10
    AS numeric), 2) AS performance_score,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (m.ergorate / 10.0) * (1 + CASE WHEN m.wristflag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END / 5.0) * (1 - ABS(m.palmangle - 15) / 45.0) * 10
    AS numeric), 2) AS comfort,
    CASE 
        WHEN ((di.dpires / 1000.0) * (1 - di.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10 > 7.5 
         AND di.dpires >= 16000 
         AND ts.pollratehz >= 1000 
         AND (m.ergorate / 10.0) * (1 + CASE WHEN m.wristflag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END / 5.0) * (1 - ABS(m.palmangle - 15) / 45.0) * 10 > 8.0
        THEN 'Premium Gaming Mouse'
        ELSE 'Not Premium'
    END AS classification
FROM testsessions ts
JOIN deviceidentity di ON ts.sessionregistry = di.devsessionref
JOIN mechanical m ON di.devregistry = m.mechdevref
WHERE ts.devscope = 'Mouse';
